name: PaliGemma: A versatile 3B VLM for transfer
problem: Task-specific VLM fine-tuning was fragmented across many bespoke models and datasets.
mechanism: SigLIP-So400m vision encoder plus the Gemma-2B language model, trained across ~40 tasks with a mix of task prefixes. The composition is deliberately plain, and the vision tower is the same SigLIP encoder recorded in pap-mm-siglip.
notes: Technical report; no peer-reviewed venue found. PaliGemma is shipped inside production stacks partly BECAUSE of its shape: a small open VLM with a frozen, standard vision tower, so its serving profile is predictable - one SigLIP pass at fixed resolution plus a 2B-parameter decoder, which fits comfortably on a single L4 or L40S. PaliGemma 2 added native resolution and Pan and Scan cropping for high-resolution inputs, which reintroduces the multi-crop token cost.
